scenario: 1 small + 1 medium + 1 large box, collected from and returned to Durham DH1 (same address, i.e. within every provider's free/local return radius), weekday collection/return, ground floor / halls reception.
packagingRule: Each worked totalGBP EXCLUDES buying boxes, because Seven Seas, Student Storage Box and DUmove's pricing include or supply boxes but The Box Co. and LOVESPACE sell theirs separately. Where boxes cost extra, the 'withPackaging' total is given inside 'arithmetic' too. Students can use their own sturdy double-walled boxes at Box Co./LOVESPACE.
durationRule: Monthly-plan providers: 4w -> 1-month plan, 15w -> 4-month plan (3.45 months rounded up), 26w -> 6-month plan, 52w -> 12-month plan. Seven Seas prices by exact dates (quote tool) so no rounding.
